title: Repair CORRECTION10 defects: skip_gate contract, hermetic /tmp paths, ReportLayout sole authority, real Ruff contract (CORRECTION11)

scope.prior_checkpoint: ACT-K9B-VERIFIER-CORE-MIGRATION-AUDIT01-CORRECTION10 (PARTIAL_CHECKPOINT; F10=4bf51fbf, S10=78be1ce8; both under rescue refs rescue/audit01-correction10-{f10,s10})

known_defects_in_cor10.skip_gate_has_no_observable_semantics: build_audit_object(..., skip_gate=...) exists as a parameter but the in-memory audit's gate_classification comes ONLY from the persisted shard or _unassessed_record(). The skip_gate flag is silently forwarded to gate_classification.classify_canonical_gate(skip=...) (which is unused by the actual write path). The flag has no observable effect on the audit object — no test directly asserts skip_gate=True produces a SKIPPED record.
known_defects_in_cor10.fixed_shared_tmp_paths_in_tests: tests/verifiers/test_verifier_core_migration_audit01.py uses Path('/tmp/cor10_adversarial'), Path('/tmp/cor10_skip_false'), Path('/tmp/cor10_skip_true') — three hard-coded shared /tmp paths. Two tests run in parallel or in sequence would collide on these paths.
known_defects_in_cor10.report_layout_partial_authority: write_all accepts either a layout OR a report_root; the legacy report_root parameter still writes a top-level file at root.parent/verifier-core-migration-audit01.json even when the layout disagrees. Construction of an inconsistent ReportLayout is not rejected.
known_defects_in_cor10.ruff_manifest_stub: test_ruff_input_equals_changed_python_paths asserts a static rglob of scripts/verifiers_audit/*.py is non-empty — it does NOT compare the ruff input to the actual changed-python paths in the F..S closure range. The detached-evidence /tmp/closure_evidence_XX/ruff-input-paths.txt is a hand-curated list, not produced by a production code path.
known_defects_in_cor10.ambiguous_writer_inputs: write_audit and write_all accept both layout and report_root — the function prefers layout but allows both. A caller can supply a layout whose shard_root differs from report_root with no error.

skip_gate_contract.choice: Contract B — remove skip_gate and AUDIT01_SKIP_GATE entirely
skip_gate_contract.rationale: Production never has a legitimate fast-skip workflow. The canonical gate_classification.json is owned exclusively by collect_r2_evidence.py; the audit object never runs the gate. The skip_gate flag is purely a unit-test convenience that defaults to False in production. Removing it eliminates a silent no-op parameter and forces tests to use explicit synthetic records via _skipped_record() / _unassessed_record() — which is the documented unit-test surface.
removals: classify_canonical_gate(skip: bool = False, skip_reason: str | None = None) parameter — REMOVE (use _skipped_record() directly)
AUDIT01_SKIP_GATE env var consumption in audit.py cli.py — REMOVE
write_audit(skip_gate: bool = False, *, layout: ReportLayout | None = None) parameter — REMOVE
retained_helpers: _skipped_record(reason) — explicit synthetic record (used by unit tests)
_unassessed_record(reason) — explicit synthetic record (used by build_audit_object when no persisted gate_classification is supplied)

hermetic_tests.no_fixed_shared_tmp_paths: Every test that constructs a path under tmp must derive it from pytest's tmp_path fixture. The fixed paths /tmp/cor10_adversarial, /tmp/cor10_skip_false, /tmp/cor10_skip_true are deleted.
hermetic_tests.guard_test: test_no_fixed_tmp_paths_in_audit_tests: source = TEST_PATH.read_text(); assert 'Path("/tmp/' not in source; assert "_P('/tmp/" not in source; assert '_P("/tmp/' not in source
hermetic_tests.every_writer_test_uses_tmp_path: Every test that calls write_audit or write_all accepts tmp_path and constructs ReportLayout via report_layout_for_shard_root(tmp_path / 'reports').
hermetic_tests.parallel_test_isolation: test_parallel_layouts_are_isolated: two independently created layouts (under two distinct tmp_path subdirectories) must not share any shard or path. Each layout's shard_root and top_level_json must be disjoint.
hermetic_tests.documented_guard: frozen modules may not write absolute shared /tmp paths (the test_no_absolute_paths_in_audit validator continues to reject /tmp/, /Users/, /home/, /var/, /private/ in the audit object).

report_layout_sole_authority.write_all_signature: def write_all(*, layout: ReportLayout, audit: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, str] — accepts ONE output description (the layout).
report_layout_sole_authority.legacy_report_root_removed: write_all(report_root=...) is removed; the only entry point is layout=.
report_layout_sole_authority.write_audit_signature: def write_audit(*, layout: ReportLayout | None = None) -> dict[str, str] — layout is the only output description; defaults to canonical_layout().
report_layout_sole_authority.report_layout_validator: ReportLayout.__post_init__ (or a class-level validator) enforces: shard_root_absolute=true, top_level_is_expected_sibling=true, markdown_is_expected_sibling=true, top_level_filename_exact=true, markdown_filename_exact=true, paths_do_not_overlap=true. An inconsistent layout raises ValueError at construction time.
report_layout_sole_authority.adversarial_test: test_inconsistent_layout_rejected_by_writer: bad = ReportLayout(shard_root=tmp_path/'shards', top_level_json=tmp_path/'wrong.json', markdown_path=tmp_path/'wrong.md'); with pytest.raises(ValueError): write_all(layout=bad, audit=audit)
report_layout_sole_authority.writes_through_layout_only: _write_atomic(layout.top_level_json, ...) and layout.markdown_path.write_bytes(...) are the only write paths in write_all.
report_layout_sole_authority.reject_ambiguous_layout_arguments: If both layout and report_root are supplied to write_audit/write_all, ValueError is raised BEFORE any write.
